name: Citizenship by Territorial Origin

qualifying_event.description: A person, or their parent, grandparent, great-grandparent, or sibling, was born or permanently resided on the territory of Ukraine before 24 August 1991 (the date of Ukraine's independence); or the applicant was born in Ukraine after 1991 to at least one permanently-resident, refugee, or stateless parent. Article 8 of the Law on Citizenship.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Birth/residence records for the applicant or the qualifying ancestor; documented family relationship where the tie is through an ancestor.

requirement_groups.name: Applicant or ancestor born/resident in Ukraine before 24 August 1991

requirements.blocker_text: Applicant, or a parent, grandparent, great-grandparent, or sibling, was born on or permanently resided within the territory of Ukraine before 24 August 1991.

Adult applicants must pass exams on the fundamentals of Ukraine's Constitution, Ukrainian history, and state-language proficiency (exempt: children, court-declared incapacitated persons, and those with certain documented disabilities).

requirement_groups.name: Born in Ukraine after 1991 to a qualifying parent

requirements.blocker_text: Born in Ukraine after 1991 to at least one parent who permanently resided there, or who was a refugee or stateless person recognised in Ukraine.

evidence_required.document: Birth/residence records establishing the qualifying tie (self or ancestor)
Constitution, history, and state-language exam pass (adults, pre-1991-tie group)

sources.title: State Migration Service of Ukraine -- Citizenship by Territorial Origin (Article 8 of the Law on Citizenship): applicant or ancestor (parent/grandparent/great-grandparent/sibling) born or resident in Ukraine before 24 August 1991, or born in Ukraine after 1991 to a qualifying parent; no ongoing residence requirement; Constitution/history/language exams for adults; free service, 3-month processing

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Ukraine). This is Ukraine's broadest diaspora-descent route -- reaching back through parent, grandparent, OR great-grandparent (a three-generation-plus window comparable to Peru's ancestry route), AND covering siblings directly, which is unusual: most descent routes in this dataset run strictly down a family line (parent-to-child), not sideways to a sibling. Notably, this route explicitly has NO ongoing residence requirement despite requiring the applicant to be physically present in Ukraine (or apply from abroad) to file -- the tier-1 source is explicit that the exams and application itself are the only substantive conditions once the ancestral tie is established, distinct from ua_citizenship_naturalisation.json's 5-year residence clock.
